title: classroom50/teams/v1
description: Machine-readable schema for <classroom>/teams.json in the org's private classroom50 config repo: the teacher-committed snapshot of INTENDED group-team membership for `team` assignments, keyed by assignment slug. For a teacher-formed assignment (team_formation: teacher) this file is the source of truth the teacher tooling reconciles GitHub Teams against; for a student-formed one it is the drift baseline clients diff live membership against (an absent assignment key means no baseline yet). It is a SNAPSHOT, not live state: GitHub Teams are authoritative for who can push, and grading credits live team membership — this file exists so intent survives membership drift and so cleanup can attribute teams after they are deleted. Rules JSON Schema cannot express, enforced in code: (1) within an assignment, team slugs are unique and their hash segment must equal GroupTeamHash(classroom, assignment) — a slug from another assignment is a hard error; (2) `members` lists are disjoint within an assignment (one student, one team); (3) member usernames are stored lowercased. Evolve additively: readers must tolerate and preserve unknown fields on a read-modify-write, since the file may be written by newer releases.

assignments.description: Assignment slug -> that assignment's group-team snapshot. `{}` (never null) at scaffold time.

teams.description: One record per group team. `[]` when the teacher has defined no teams yet.

slug.description: The GitHub Team slug (== name) `classroom50-group-<hash>-<n>`. The hash segment must equal GroupTeamHash of this classroom and the bucket's assignment slug (enforced in code).

id.description: The live team's numeric id, recorded at creation. Destructive deletes confirm the live team still carries this id before acting (the TeamIdMismatchError pattern), so a reused slug is never clobbered blind. Absent on a record written before the team existed (e.g., a planned import).

name.description: Human-readable display name (e.g., "The Sharks"). Display metadata only — never part of the slug. Mirrored into the team's classroom50/group/v1 description record. Omitted when the team has no display name.

members.description: Intended member usernames, lowercased. May be [] for a teacher-created placeholder team awaiting assignment. INTENT, not live state: clients diff this against live GitHub Team membership to surface drift.

formation.description: Who founded this team, recorded so a mixed history stays auditable after the assignment's team_formation is edited. Omitted when unknown (a backfilled snapshot).
